# Velocity Car Detailing

> The top-rated professional mobile car detailing service in Bozeman, Montana. We serve Bozeman, Belgrade, Four Corners, Big Sky, and all of Gallatin County. We come to you — no drop-off required.

## Who We Are

Velocity Car Detailing is Bozeman's premier mobile auto detailing company. We specialize in professional-grade paint correction, ceramic coating, interior detailing, exterior detailing, boat detailing, and fleet detailing. Every service is performed on-location at your home or workplace by trained detailing technicians using professional products and equipment.

- **Phone:** (612) 434-5327

- **Hours:** Sunday–Friday 8am–6pm | Saturday closed | By appointment only
- **Business type:** Mobile auto detailing — we come to the customer

## Services

### Car Detailing Bozeman MT
Full-service interior and exterior car detailing for all vehicle types. Includes hand wash, decontamination, polish, and protection. Best mobile car detailing in Bozeman, MT.
https://www.velocitydetailingmt.com/car-detailing-bozeman-mt

### Ceramic Coating Bozeman MT
Professional ceramic coating application for cars, trucks, and SUVs in Bozeman, MT. Includes full paint decontamination, paint correction as needed, and multi-year coating warranty. Protects against road salt, UV, and Montana weather.
https://www.velocitydetailingmt.com/ceramic-coating-bozeman-mt

### Boat Detailing Bozeman MT
Mobile boat detailing for pontoons, fishing boats, ski boats, and watercraft throughout Gallatin County. Oxidation removal, hull cleaning, interior detailing, and protective coating.
https://www.velocitydetailingmt.com/boat-detailing-bozeman-mt

### Fleet Detailing Bozeman MT
Commercial fleet detailing for businesses in Bozeman and surrounding areas. We detail work trucks, vans, company vehicles, and large fleets on a recurring schedule.
https://www.velocitydetailingmt.com/fleet-detailing-bozeman-mt

### Paint Correction Bozeman MT
Single and two-stage machine paint correction to remove swirl marks, scratches, water spots, and oxidation. Essential before ceramic coating application.

### Interior Detailing Bozeman MT
Deep interior cleaning including vacuuming, carpet shampoo, leather conditioning, stain removal, odor elimination, pet hair removal, and glass cleaning.
